summary: Mads benchmarked Gemini 4 Argon across Devin and Droid with a prompt to build a 3D anatomical heart, comparing generation times and 3D visual fidelity.
summaryEn: 3D Anatomical Heart Comparison via Devin and Droid

post.originalText:
Gave Gemini 4 Argon (high) the same prompt in @DevinAI and @droid: build a 3D anatomical heart

Devin: 8:11 min
Droid: ~19 min

I like Devins result more. Droid felt like it had latency issues all day today, so not sure if the long time comes from that, its not usual for me. Wanted to add Opus 5.5 too but in Droid it aborted after exactly 2407s of reasoning, 4th time today

planning more harness comparisons like this, let me know if you want more
